patterns.note: The hero section features a full-bleed product image with the brand name 'STEL' displayed in an extremely large, vertically oriented, and condensed sans-serif font, creating a strong visual anchor.
A clear distinction between a bold, condensed display font for the brand name and a clean, legible sans-serif for navigation and body text, establishing a hierarchy of visual importance.
A minimalist black and white color scheme dominates the interface, allowing product photography to introduce the primary visual interest and color.
The main navigation bar transforms into a sticky header upon scroll, losing the 'Free Shipping' top bar and remaining fixed at the top of the viewport.
The large 'STEL' brand name in the hero section appears to parallax slightly or scroll at a different rate than the background image, creating a subtle depth effect before it scrolls out of view.
A scroll-triggered newsletter signup modal appears mid-page, interrupting the flow with a direct call to action after initial content has been viewed.

technique_notes: To rebuild the hero, use a full-width image container with a large, vertically aligned text overlay. Implement a subtle parallax effect where the text scrolls at a slightly slower rate than the background image, eventually scrolling out of view.

The navigation bar should be designed with two states: an initial state with a top promotional bar, and a sticky state that activates on scroll, removing the promotional bar and fixing the navigation to the top of the viewport.
Implement a scroll-triggered modal that appears after the user scrolls past a certain percentage of the page height, presenting a newsletter signup form.

design_tokens.type_scale: An extremely oversized, condensed sans-serif display font (~10x body) for the brand name, contrasted with a clean, standard sans-serif for navigation and body text.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy hero, with significant vertical white space between the hero and the footer, creating a sense of spaciousness and focus on the primary content.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost architectural use of typography in the hero section, where the brand name 'STEL' is a dominant, vertically oriented graphic element. This, combined with the minimalist aesthetic and significant white space, creates a high-fashion, editorial feel that prioritizes brand presence over immediate product display.
